viewing_check: Check a lead is truly missing (no AV/RF cable means it cannot be tested; a replacement lead is cheap), power pack is the right PAL SMS one, console and pad ports undamaged, read the two hidden cart labels (any Phantasy Star, Sonic, Alex Kidd or boxed or rare titles would lift value), and cart label condition.
